# Specific Role Rule 2: Assistants/D-Class
- Assistant is a role intended for new players to learn how to play the game. - Hijacking either of these roles to self antag will result in a server ban. - If you want to freely self antag, enable insurgent in your character settings. It is Assistant/D-Class with self-antag rights. - D-Class only refers to crew-aligned D-Class, which are those who spawn from the lobby. D-Class who spawn from the ghostrole are free agents.
